newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Driving lessons for Israel's transport minister.
newsitem.headline: Driving lessons for Israel's transport minister.

text.p: It's back to class for a refresher course on the rules of the road for Israel's transport minister after two speeding violations, Israeli media said on Wednesday.

The course is compulsory under a points system which tallies up driving convictions. "I wholeheartedly hope that they (the violations) will be the last," Levy, who is also a rabbi, told Israel's Itim news agency.
